en-US.description: See and use previous text copied in the clipboard
en-US.longDescription:
Japplis Clipboard History Pro - Show Text Clipboard History
Clipboard History Pro remembers the text copied in the clipboard from other applications. You can see the list of previous copied text and put them back in the clipboard.
en-US.name: Japplis Clipboard History Pro
